fix.pr_body:
## What was wrong

Tournament reminder embeds sent to the Discord channel did not mention the MTGO game timer setting, so players sometimes used non-default timers and ran into time issues during Penny Dreadful tournaments.

## What changed

Added one `embed.add_field` call inside `background_task_tournament_reminders()` in `discordbot/background.py` (inside the `diff <= 14400` block, just before the embed is sent). The new field reads:
- **Name:** `Game timer:`
- **Value:** `Set your MTGO game timer to 25 minutes (the default).`

This field appears on every tournament reminder sent within 4 hours of the event start, alongside the existing countdown and pre-registration link fields.

## Validation

- `uv run --frozen python dev.py lint` — passed (all checks clean)
- Unit tests for `discordbot/background.py` — `not-applicable`: there are no existing unit tests for `background_task_tournament_reminders`; it is an async Discord-gateway-dependent task with no test harness in the repo. The database was also unavailable in this cloud environment.

Fixes #11747
